findings.source_quote: How can we live a morally pure life? Be Humble. James 5 says, “Confess your faults one to another that ye may be healed.” Be Honest. Be transparent. Romans 2:16 tells of the day when God will judge the secrets of men. Tell yourself the truth. Teach your eyes to bounce. Teaching our children. Keep your emotions. Flee lust and fornication.

findings.source_quote:
Two forces lie within my breast,
    The one I love, the one I hate.
    But the one I feed will dominate.

—The author’s dad

The more honestly I name
    what is true about myself,
    The less I need to hide and defend,
    and posture and pretend.

—Dan Allender
